login.title: your project
login.intro: Enter the email address you booked with and I'll send you a link to sign in. No password needed.
login.sentText: If {email} belongs to a project, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once and for 30 minutes.
login.error: Something went wrong — please try again in a moment.
login.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one below.
login.signedOut: You're signed out. See you soon!
login.noProject: No project yet? Plan your shoot →

verify.title: one click and you're in
verify.text: Click the button to open your project space.
verify.missing: This link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.

home.empty: No projects here yet — once we've planned your shoot, it shows up here.

project.questions: Questions? Just reply to any of my emails —
project.notFound: This project doesn't exist or isn't yours.

inquiry.label: Inquiry
inquiry.next: I'm reading your request and will get back to you shortly.

proposal.label: Proposal
proposal.next: Your proposal is on its way or already in your inbox. Once you accept it, your date is booked.

booked.label: Booked
booked.next: Your date is booked. Next, we'll plan the details together.

planning.label: Planning
planning.next: We're planning the shoot — place, schedule and ideas. Tell me anything that comes to mind.

shoot.label: Shoot
shoot.next: Shoot day! Afterwards I'll pick the best frames for your sneak peek.

sneak-peek.label: Sneak peek
sneak-peek.next: A first selection is ready — have a look and tell me what you think.

proofing.label: Selection
proofing.next: Pick your favourites from the previews — those are the ones I'll edit.

editing.label: Editing
editing.next: I'm editing your photos. You'll hear from me as soon as they're ready.

revisions.label: Revisions
revisions.next: Your edits are ready to review — approve them or tell me what to change.

delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.next: Your final photos are ready to download. The gallery stays online for 12 months.

feedback.label: Feedback
feedback.next: How was it? I'd love to hear your thoughts.

archive.label: Archive
archive.next: This project is complete — thank you for working with me!
